Working notes:
- apply time frames based on tranche dates
1st collection: 2022-09-30
2nd collection: 2024-03-31
3rd collection: 2025-04-07

libraries
```{r : reading libraries, include= FALSE}
packages <- c("tidyverse", "readxl", "dplyr", "magrittr", "mixtools", "emmeans", "readr","data.table", "lubridate", "ggplot2", "skimr", "ggstatsplot","summarytools", "knitr", "here", "ggthemes", "Amelia", "tidyr", "naniar", "stringr", "janitor", "ggbreak", "patchwork", "plotrix", "viridis", "hrbrthemes", "showtext")

lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
```

```{r : set up #2}
# read in data
all_data <- read.csv("Outputs/Dataframe outputs/April 24 Extract (for Irina)/all_data_ICAH_children_2025.csv", header=T, na.strings= c("", "NA"))

# colours
myColours <- c("purple", "lightblue", "grey")

# add font
font_add(family = "Arial", regular = "Arial.ttf")

all_data$Centre.ID.x <- as.factor(all_data$Centre.ID.x)

all_data$Date.of.Assessment <- as.Date(all_data$Date.of.Assessment, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# make time frames based on tranche dates
before_2022 <- all_data %>%
  filter(Date.of.Assessment <= "2022-09-30")

first_to_second <- all_data %>%
  filter(Date.of.Assessment > "2022-09-30" & Date.of.Assessment <= "2024-03-31")

second_to_third <- all_data %>%
  filter(Date.of.Assessment > "2024-03-31")
```

```{r : violin plot - height SDS for BA}
heightforBA <- Violin(all_data, "HeightSDSforBA", "None", "HeightSDS for Bone age (all data)")

heightforBA_before_first_collection <- Violin(before_2022, "HeightSDSforBA", "None", "HeightSDS for Bone age (before first collection)")

heightforBA_2022_2024 <- Violin(first_to_second, "HeightSDSforBA", "None", "HeightSDS for Bone age (2022-2024)")

heightforBA_2024_2025 <- Violin(second_to_third, "HeightSDSforBA", "None", "HeightSDS for Bone age (2024-2025)")
```


```{r : violin plot - height SDS for chronological age}
heightforCA <- Violin(all_data, "HeightSDS", "HeightSDS for chronological age (all data)", -4) + ylim(-5,5)

heightforCA_before_first_collection <- Violin(before_2022, "HeightSDS", "HeightSDS for chronological age (before first collection)", -4) + ylim(-5,5)

heightforCA_2022_2024 <- Violin(first_to_second, "HeightSDS", "HeightSDS for chronological age (2022-2024)", -4) + ylim(-5,5)

heightforCA_2024_2025 <- Violin(second_to_third, "HeightSDS", "HeightSDS for chronological age (2024-2025)", -4) + ylim(-5,5)
```


```{r : violin plots}
BMI_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = BMISDS, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  ylim(-5, 7.5) +
  ggtitle("BMISDS") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2))

  ggtitle("HeightSDS") +

OHP_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = `X17.OHP.value`, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("17OHP concentrations") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, colour = "red") +
  annotate('rect', xmin=-Inf, xmax=Inf, ymin=10, ymax=36, alpha=.5, fill='grey')

andro_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = Androstenedione.value, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("Androstenedione concentrations") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
  scale_y_break(c(20,30,55,70), scale = 0.25) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 70, by = 2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 8, colour = "red")

testosterone_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = `Total.testosterone.value`, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("Testosterone concentrations") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 2.5))

# add in age category grouping
testosterone_violin2 <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = `Total.testosterone.value`, fill = Age.category)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("Testosterone concentrations") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 2.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = myColours) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 1),
                 aes(group = Age.category)) 


# introduce age category
# only need age category for males so will need to do some powerpoint cropping
    testosterone_all_violin_2 <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = Total.testosterone.value, fill = Age.category, col = Sex.at.birth)) +
      geom_violin() +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 2.5)) +
      labs(title = "Testosterone 22-25", x = "Centre ID", y = "Total.testosterone.value") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = myColours) +
      geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
                 aes(group = Age.category))
#

renin_violin <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = Renin.plasma.activity, fill = Sex.at.birth)) +
  geom_violin() +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("Renin plasma activity") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(seed = 1, width = 0.2)) +
  scale_y_break(c(60, 100), scale = 0.25)

```

```{r : biomarker plots}
# have played around with various axis breaks and y scales to get data to look as clear as possible...
## testosterone
testosterone_all <- MDBoxPlot(all_data, "Total.testosterone.value", "Sex only", "Testosterone") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 2.5))

# introduce age category
# only need age category for males so will need to do some powerpoint cropping
    testosterone_all2 <- ggplot(all_data, aes(x = Sex.at.birth, y = Total.testosterone.value, fill = Age.category, col = Sex.at.birth)) +
      geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge2(preserve='single'),) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 2.5)) +
      labs(title = "Testosterone", x = "Centre ID", y = "Total.testosterone.value") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = myColours) +
      geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
                 aes(group = Age.category))
#

## renin plasma activity
renin_all <- MDBoxPlot(all_data, "Renin.plasma.activity", "Sex only", "Renin plasma activiy") +
scale_y_break(c(60, 100), scale = 0.25)

## 17OHP
OHP_all <- MDBoxPlot(all_data, "X17.OHP.value", "Sex only", "17 OHP values") +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")  +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, colour = "red") +
  annotate('rect', xmin=-Inf, xmax=Inf, ymin=10, ymax=36, alpha=.5, fill='grey')

##andro
andro_all <- MDBoxPlot(all_data, "Androstenedione.value", "Sex only", "Andro values") +
  scale_y_break(c(20,30,55,70), scale = 0.1) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 75, by = 2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 8, colour = "red")
```
